actions.name: R4-1 Two Catch Blocks Sharing A Name
actions.description: Two sibling try-catch blocks both using err. Suspected cause of the silent halts.

actions.name: R4-2 Two Catch Blocks With Distinct Names
actions.description: Same shape as R4-1 but with errA and errB. Isolates name collision from try-catch itself.

actions.name: R4-3 Same Const Name In Sibling Blocks
actions.description: Declares const value in two sibling blocks, testing whether block scope is flattened.

actions.name: R4-4 Static Call Inside And Outside Try
actions.description: Runs Object.keys on an object literal directly and inside a try block.

actions.name: R4-5 Static Built-in Access
actions.description: Eighteen static helpers as plain statements with stage markers and no try-catch.

actions.name: R4-6 Permission Denial
actions.description: Touches ungranted capabilities as plain statements with stage markers and no try-catch. Select the sandbox tracks first.
